long_biography.plain_text:
Flavio Briatore built championship teams around young drivers whose potential he recognised early. At Benetton, Michael Schumacher won consecutive drivers’ titles; at Renault, Fernando Alonso repeated that achievement. Briatore’s management combined driver recruitment with a strong emphasis on marketing and sponsorship, treating the racing operation as a commercial organisation as well as a sporting team.

His involvement in talent development extended beyond the team garage. He established FB Management to scout and represent drivers, with a roster that included Giancarlo Fisichella, Jarno Trulli and Fernando Alonso. He also helped create GP2 as a championship alongside Formula One, giving developing drivers and engineers a competitive arena before progressing to the senior series.
